name: Sequencer grooves, measured from the stems
description: One 4-bar loop per song, taken from the song files songscribe made from the six stems: the best-graded section that has drums and bass, with its guitar / piano / other sketches (voice left out). Start a song row (its name is the short id) and its tempo token sets the bank tempo. Drums are measured (the grade is how well the row reproduces the hits found in the drum stem); bass and chords are sketches. iran = I Ran (So Far Away) (Video) — A Flock Of Seagulls · dywm = Don't You Want Me (Official Music Video) — The Human League · rule = Everybody Wants To Rule The World — Tears For Fears · ifeel = I Feel Love 1977 (Remastered) — Donna Summer · cars = Cars (Remastered 2009) — Gary Numan · pjesus = Personal Jesus (Official Video) — Depeche Mode · whipit = Whip It — Devo · relax = Relax — Frankie Goes To Hollywood · callme = Blondie - Call me — BlondieMusicOfficial
prompt: banks of sequencer songs in MPL
